title: 01 · Main editing surface
description: Live graph, palette and scoped property inspector. Source editing remains available through a drawer, not as the main authoring task.

title: 02 · Field-specific meaning
description: A field selection preserves its owner and ID. The advanced domain picker is a proposed workflow; label/connection actions are live.

title: 03 · Connection creation
description: Real source/target field selectors and a semantic relation type. Geometric routing is deliberately absent from this meaning sheet.

title: 04 · Appearance and pinning
description: Live hand-drawn/night output. Source and semantics remain unchanged by preview controls; pin fields are explicit source operations.

title: 05 · Arrangement choices
description: A live whole-view layout selection. Future selected-region preview and persistent policy commands are separately specified.

title: 06 · Projection-aware workspace
description: Real RACI rendering. Inapplicable free-graph gestures are disabled; the right panel exposes the intended source bindings.

title: 07 · Data-bound chart
description: Real native chart with source-bound marks. Data editing is separate from arbitrary shape movement.

title: 08 · Kind conversion review
description: Storyboard, not executed: lists retained meaning, dependencies and migration questions before a type change.

title: 09 · Incomplete design obligations
description: Storyboard, not executed: recoverable incomplete graph design with strict review/export still required.

title: 10 · Source inspection
description: The current DDN generated by actual prototype actions. Comments and stable references remain visible.

title: 11 · Downloads
description: Live current DDN, workspace ZIP and SVG. Source downloads are not redacted publications.

title: 12 · Reduced desktop width
description: 1180-pixel desktop composition. This is not a claim of complete mobile editing or assistive-tech qualification.
